title: Rights group says M23, Rwandan army commit atrocities in DRC’s Uvira
summary: M23 rebels and ⁠the Rwandan ​army carried out killings, rapes and abductions during a ​month-long occupation of Uvira in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo in late 2025 and early 2026, Human Rights Watch said ​in ‌a report on Thursday.
